positions.subject: q:education/sfusd-proximity-assignment
positions.summary: In August 2026 Lee told Mission Local he supports moving forward with area-based school assignments. In October he said he would have voted for Option B, citing its neighborhood guarantee for families applying on time and its broader school choice; Option B guarantees a neighborhood seat to on-time applicants and lets families apply to any school in the district.

citations.quote: Yes. I support moving forward with area-based school assignments.
I would have supported B for its neighborhood guarantee for families applying on time and broader school choice.
“Option B” would have allowed families to apply to any school in the district, while still guaranteeing a neighborhood seat to families that applied for one in time.
While Lee leans toward a zone-based enrollment system, he says, “I don’t have any solutions, but it should address the major top concerns.”
